Text: Lord Jesus Christ, You place a pleasant yoke and light burden upon the meek and humble who follow You. May our lives reflect Your heart. [t] Receive our day's devotion and work, [*] and give Your peace to our spirits and night. Hold us near in rest, that we may rise more ready to serve You
